story: Early in the race, eight riders form a breakaway. On the Jaizkibel, the break splits and the peloton catches the last escapees. Evenepoel suffers a puncture before the Erlaitz climb but recovers and rejoins the leaders. He attacks on the final climb, only Carapaz follows. Evenepoel outsprints him to win his 4th San Sebastian, becoming sole record holder.
